name: Alchemist's Supplies
summary: Alchemist's supplies enable a character to produce useful concoctions, such as acid or alchemist's fire.
canDo: Alchemical Crafting: You can use this tool proficiency to create alchemical items.
Create a puff of thick smoke
Refine Monster Reagents: Process suitable harvested monster parts into stable ingredients for alchemical crafting.
Analyze an unknown liquid or chemical mixture
components: Alchemist's supplies include two glass beakers, a metal frame to hold a beaker in place over an open flame, a glass stirring rod, a small mortar and pestle, and a pouch of common alchemical ingredients, including salt, powdered iron, and purified water.

skillUses.text: Proficiency with alchemist's supplies allows you to unlock more information on Arcana checks involving potions and similar materials.
When you inspect an area for clues, proficiency with alchemist's supplies grants additional insight into any chemicals or other substances that might have been used in the area.

features.name: Alchemical Crafting
features.text: You can use this tool proficiency to create alchemical items. A character can spend money to collect raw materials, which weigh 1 pound for every 50 gp spent. The DM can allow a character to make a check using the indicated skill with advantage. As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can use alchemist's supplies to make one dose of acid, alchemist's fire, antitoxin, oil, perfume, or soap. Subtract half the value of the created item from the total gp worth of raw materials you are carrying.

features.name: Potion Brewing
features.text: You can use alchemist's supplies to craft non-healing potions when you have an appropriate formula, suitable reagents, and raw materials. This includes potions such as resistance, growth, diminution, water breathing, or giant strength. Healing potions remain the domain of the herbalism kit unless another rule says otherwise.

features.name: Refine Reagents
features.text: Given suitable raw materials, you can process monster parts, minerals, acids, salts, and similar substances into stable alchemical reagents. The resulting reagent does not gain value from nothing; its value is based on the materials used, the difficulty of refinement, and the quality of the finished product.

activities.activity: Create a puff of thick smoke
Identify a poison
Identify a substance
Start a fire
Neutralize acid
Analyze an unknown liquid or chemical mixture
Refine a difficult alchemical reagent
Stabilize a volatile alchemical mixture
Identify the likely properties of an unfamiliar potion from residue

name: Brewer's Supplies
summary: Brewing is the art of producing beer. Not only does beer serve as an alcoholic beverage, but the process of brewing purifies water. Crafting beer takes weeks of fermentation, but only a few hours of work.
canDo: Potable Water: Your knowledge of brewing enables you to purify water that would otherwise be undrinkable.
Detect poison or impurities in a drink
Identify a spoiled or contaminated brew
Identify an unfamiliar fermented food or drink
components: Brewer's supplies include a large glass jug, a quantity of hops, a siphon, and several feet of tubing.

skillUses.text: Proficiency with brewer's supplies gives you additional insight on Intelligence (History) checks concerning events that involve alcohol as a significant element.
This tool proficiency grants additional insight when you treat anyone suffering from alcohol poisoning or when you can use alcohol to dull pain.
A stiff drink can help soften the hardest heart. Your proficiency with brewer's supplies can help you ply someone with drink, giving them just enough alcohol to mellow their mood.

features.name: Potable Water
features.text: Your knowledge of brewing enables you to purify water that would otherwise be undrinkable. As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can purify up to 6 gallons of water, or 1 gallon as part of a quick rest (classic short rest).

features.name: Controlled Fermentation
features.text: Your knowledge of yeast, temperature, storage, and fermentation lets you deliberately sour, ferment, or preserve suitable ingredients. You can produce mundane products such as vinegar, fermented fruit, brewing starters, and similar ingredients when given enough time and proper containers.

activities.activity: Detect poison or impurities in a drink
Identify alcohol
Ignore effects of alcohol
Judge the progress of fermentation
Identify a spoiled or contaminated brew
Identify an unfamiliar fermented food or drink

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
summary: Calligraphy treats writing as a delicate, beautiful art. Calligraphers produce text that is pleasing to the eye, using a style that is difficult to forge. Their supplies also give them some ability to examine scripts and determine if they are legitimate, since a calligrapher's training involves long hours of studying writing and attempting to replicate its style and design.
canDo: Decipher Treasure Map: This tool proficiency grants you expertise in examining maps.
Copy unfamiliar runes or script accurately
Create coded writing hidden in decorative lettering
components: Calligrapher's supplies include ink, a dozen sheets of parchment, and three quills.

skillUses.text: Although calligraphy is of little help in deciphering the content of magical writings, proficiency with these supplies can aid in identifying who wrote a script of a magical nature.

This tool proficiency can augment the benefit of successful checks made to analyze or investigate ancient writings, scrolls, or other texts, including runes etched in stone or messages in frescoes or other displays.

features.name: Decipher Treasure Map
features.text: This tool proficiency grants you expertise in examining maps. You can make an Intelligence check to determine a map's age, whether a map includes any hidden messages, or similar facts.

features.name: Exact Copy
features.text: Given a clear original, you can reproduce the visible layout, lettering, diagrams, and decorative elements of a page with high accuracy. This does not by itself create a legal forgery or duplicate a magical effect, but it is useful for preserving inscriptions, runes, diagrams, and damaged texts.

features.name: Illumination
features.text: You can decorate manuscripts with borders, initials, symbols, and miniature illustrations, creating ceremonial books, charters, certificates, and other formal works.

activities.activity: Identify writer of nonmagical script
Determine writer's state of mind
Spot forged text
Forge a signature
Copy unfamiliar script accurately
Create an illuminated manuscript page
Hide a coded message in decorative lettering

name: Carpenter's Tools
summary: Skill at carpentry enables a character to construct wooden structures. A carpenter can build a house, a shack, a wooden cabinet, or similar items.
canDo: Fortify: With 1 minute of work and raw materials, you can make a door or window harder to force open.
Temporary Shelter: As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can construct a lean-to or a similar shelter to keep your group dry and in the shade for the duration of the rest.
Find a weak point in a wooden wall
Craft Hidden Compartment: Add a concealed space to a suitable wooden object or structure.
Find a hidden compartment in wooden construction
Build a barricade or wooden reinforcement
components: Carpenter's tools include a saw, a hammer, nails, a hatchet, a square, a ruler, an adze, a plane, and a chisel.

skillUses.text: This tool proficiency aids you in identifying the use and the origin of wooden buildings and other large wooden objects.
You gain additional insight when inspecting areas within wooden structures, because you know tricks of construction that can conceal areas from discovery.
You can spot irregularities in wooden walls or floors, making it easier to find trap doors and secret passages.
You can quickly assess the weak spots in a wooden floor, making it easier to avoid the places that creak and groan when they're stepped on.

features.name: Fortify
features.text: With 1 minute of work and raw materials, you can make a door or window harder to force open. Increase the DC needed to open it by 5.

features.name: Temporary Shelter
features.text: As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can construct a lean-to or a similar shelter to keep your group dry and in the shade for the duration of the rest. Because it was fashioned quickly from whatever wood was available, the shelter collapses 1d3 days after being assembled.

features.name: Craft Hidden Compartment
features.text: With 8 hours of work and suitable materials, you can add a hidden compartment to a wooden object or structure large enough to contain it, such as a chest, cabinet, wall panel, floor, wagon, or piece of furniture. Make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency; the total becomes the Intelligence (Investigation) check DC needed to find the compartment.

features.name: Wooden Construction
features.text: You can construct mundane wooden fixtures, containers, furniture, barricades, frames, ladders, scaffolding, and similar structures when you have enough lumber, fasteners, and working space.

activities.activity: Build a simple wooden structure
Design a complex wooden structure
Find a weak point in a wooden wall
Pry apart a door
Build a sturdy wooden chest or crate
Build a barricade or reinforcement
Craft a hidden compartment in wooden construction
Find a hidden compartment in wooden construction

name: Cartographer's Tools
summary: Using cartographer's tools, you can create accurate maps to make travel easier for yourself and those who come after you. These maps can range from large-scale depictions of mountain ranges to diagrams that show the layout of a dungeon level.
canDo: Craft a Map: While traveling, you can draw a map as you go in addition to engaging in other activity.
Determine a map's age and origin
Estimate direction and distance to a landmark
Discern that a map is fake
Fill in a missing part of a map
Create a dungeon floorplan while exploring
Estimate travel distance and travel time from a map
Compare old and new maps to identify geographic changes
Plan a practical route through known terrain
components: Cartographer's tools consist of a quill, ink, parchment, a pair of compasses, calipers, and a ruler.

skillUses.text: You can use your knowledge of maps and locations to unearth more detailed information when you use these skills. For instance, you might spot hidden messages in a map, identify when the map was made to determine if geographical features have changed since then, and so forth.
Your familiarity with physical geography makes it easier for you to answer questions or solve issues relating to the terrain around you.

Your understanding of geography makes it easier to find paths to civilization, to predict areas where villages or towns might be found, and to avoid becoming lost. You have studied so many maps that common patterns, such as how trade routes evolve and where settlements arise in relation to geographic locations, are familiar to you.

features.name: Craft a Map
features.text: While traveling, you can draw a map as you go in addition to engaging in other activity.

features.name: Route Planning
features.text: Given a reasonably accurate map and known destination, you can estimate the distance, likely travel time, major terrain obstacles, and obvious alternative routes. This feature cannot reveal hazards or geography that are absent from the available information.

features.name: Survey Sketch
features.text: When you can observe a location from a useful vantage point, you can create a practical sketch showing relative distances, elevations, roads, rivers, structures, and other major features.

activities.activity: Determine a map's age and origin
Estimate direction and distance to a landmark
Discern that a map is fake
Fill in a missing part of a map
Estimate travel time along a mapped route
Create a useful floorplan from memory
Reconstruct missing local geography from surrounding information
Identify significant geographic changes between two maps

name: Cobbler's Tools
summary: Although the cobbler's trade might seem too humble for an adventurer, a good pair of boots will see a character across rugged wilderness and through deadly dungeons.
canDo: Maintain Shoes: As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can repair your companions' shoes.
Craft Hidden Compartment: With 8 hours of work, you can add a hidden compartment to a pair of shoes.
Determine a shoe's age and origin
Find a hidden compartment in a boot heel
Fit simple snow, mud, ice, or climbing attachments to footwear
Assess a traveler's recent terrain from wear on footwear
components: Cobbler's tools consist of a hammer, an awl, a knife, a shoe stand, a cutter, spare leather, and thread.

skillUses.text: Your knowledge of shoes aids you in identifying the magical properties of enchanted boots or the history of such items.

Footwear holds a surprising number of secrets. You can learn where someone has recently visited by examining the wear and the dirt that has accumulated on their shoes. Your experience in repairing shoes makes it easier for you to identify where damage might come from.

features.name: Maintain Shoes
features.text: As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can repair your companions' shoes. For the next 24 hours, up to six creatures of your choice who wear shoes you worked on can travel up to 10 hours a day without making saving throws to avoid exhaustion.

features.name: Craft Hidden Compartment
features.text: With 8 hours of work, you can add a hidden compartment to a pair of shoes. The compartment can hold an object up to 3 inches long and 1 inch wide and deep. You make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency to determine the Intelligence (Investigation) check DC needed to find the compartment.

features.name: Terrain Footwear
features.text: With suitable materials and 1 hour of work, you can adapt a pair of mundane footwear for a specific ordinary environment, such as deep mud, snow, ice, rocky ground, or prolonged wet conditions. These adaptations do not grant magical movement, but they can negate minor footwear-related penalties or inconveniences at the DM's discretion.

activities.activity: Determine a shoe's age and origin
Find a hidden compartment in a boot heel
Waterproof a pair of boots
Fit terrain-specific attachments to footwear
Determine recent terrain from wear on footwear

name: Cook's Utensils
summary: Adventuring is a hard life. With a cook along on the journey, your meals will be much better than the typical mix of hardtack and dried fruit.
canDo: Prepare Meals: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can prepare a tasty meal that helps your companions regain their strength.
Spot poison or impurities in food
Safely prepare unfamiliar edible plants or monster meat
Stretch limited ingredients into a serviceable meal
components: Cook's utensils include a metal pot, knives, forks, a stirring spoon, and a ladle.

skillUses.text: Your knowledge of cooking techniques allows you to assess the social patterns involved in a culture's eating habits.
When administering treatment, you can transform medicine that is bitter or sour into a pleasing concoction.
When foraging for food, you can make do with ingredients you scavenge that others would be unable to transform into nourishing meals.

features.name: Prepare Meals
features.text: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can prepare a tasty meal that helps your companions regain their strength. You and up to five creatures of your choice regain 1 extra hit point per Hit Die spent during a quick rest (classic short rest), provided you have access to your cook's utensils and sufficient food.

features.name: Preserve Food
features.text: Given salt, smoke, sugar, oil, vinegar, drying space, or another appropriate method, you can preserve suitable food for travel and storage. The exact shelf life depends on the ingredient, preservation method, and local conditions.

features.name: Unusual Ingredients
features.text: Your training lets you assess how unfamiliar but potentially edible ingredients should be cleaned, cut, cooked, soaked, or otherwise prepared to reduce ordinary culinary hazards. This does not automatically make inherently poisonous or magical material safe.

activities.activity: Create a typical meal
Duplicate a meal
Spot poison or impurities in food
Create a gourmet meal
Preserve a batch of food
Identify spoiled food
Safely prepare an unfamiliar edible ingredient
Stretch limited ingredients into a full meal

name: Glassblower's Tools
summary: Someone who is proficient with glassblower's tools has not only the ability to shape glass, but also specialized knowledge of the methods used to produce glass objects.
canDo: Identify Weakness: With 1 minute of study, you can identify the weak points in a glass object.
Determine what a glass object once held
Restore a simple glass object if enough of it remains
components: The tools include a blowpipe, a small marver, blocks, and tweezers. You need a source of heat to work glass.

skillUses.text: Your knowledge of glassmaking techniques aids you when you examine glass objects, such as potion bottles or glass items found in a treasure hoard. For instance, you can study how a glass potion bottle has been changed by its contents to help determine a potion's effects. (A potion might leave behind a residue, deform the glass, or stain it.)
When you study an area, your knowledge can aid you if the clues include broken glass or glass objects.

features.name: Identify Weakness
features.text: With 1 minute of study, you can identify the weak points in a glass object. Any damage dealt to the object by striking a weak spot is doubled.

features.name: Glass Vessel Crafting
features.text: With an adequate heat source and suitable glass, you can create mundane vials, potion bottles, flasks, jars, ampoules, tubes, beakers, and similar containers. Fine laboratory pieces or pressure-resistant vessels may require a higher check.

features.name: Precision Glasswork
features.text: You can shape delicate ornaments, figurines, lenses, mirrors, and specialized laboratory glass. Complex optical pieces require high-quality glass and careful finishing.

activities.activity: Identify source of glass
Determine what a glass object once held
Craft a simple vial, bottle, or jar
Craft a decorative glass ornament
Craft delicate laboratory glassware
Craft a precision lens or intricate glass figurine

name: Jeweler's Tools
summary: Training with jeweler's tools includes the basic techniques needed to beautify gems. It also gives you expertise in identifying precious stones.
canDo: Identify Gems: You can identify gems and determine their value at a glance.
Craft Small Precious-Metal Objects and Figurines
Engrave a detailed symbol or image into a precious object
Appraise the quality of precious-metal workmanship
components: Jeweler's tools consist of a small saw and hammer, files, pliers, and tweezers.

skillUses.text: Proficiency with jeweler's tools grants you knowledge about the reputed mystical uses of gems. This insight proves handy when you make Arcana checks related to gems or gem-encrusted items.
When you inspect jeweled objects, your proficiency with jeweler's tools aids you in picking out clues they might hold.

features.name: Identify Gems
features.text: You can identify gems and determine their value at a glance.

features.name: Precious Component Crafting
features.text: You can craft compact nonmagical objects intended to satisfy a spell's specified material component, such as an engraved figurine, jeweled icon, ornament, jewels with holy symbols or precious-metal focus, provided the finished object actually meets the spell's description and required value. Note: Crafting does not create value from nothing: the value must come from precious materials, workmanship, rarity, or a combination of them.

features.name: Fine Engraving
features.text: You can engrave detailed images, lettering, heraldry, runes, and decorative patterns onto suitable gems, jewelry, and small precious-metal objects.

activities.activity: Modify a gem's appearance
Determine a gem's history
Set a gemstone securely
Engrave a detailed symbol or image
Craft a small precious figurine or ornament
Craft a masterwork valuable spell component

name: Leatherworker's Tools
summary: Knowledge of leatherworking extends to lore concerning animal hides and their properties. It also confers knowledge of leather armor and similar goods.
canDo: Identify Hides: When looking at a hide or a leather item, you can determine the source of the leather and any special techniques used to treat it.
Craft Belts, Harnesses, Scabbards, and Holsters
Add a concealed pocket to a suitable leather item
Fit leather gear to a specific creature
components: Leatherworker's tools include a knife, a small mallet, an edger, a hole punch, thread, and leather scraps.

skillUses.text: Your expertise in working with leather grants you added insight when you inspect magic items crafted from leather, such as boots and some cloaks.
You gain added insight when studying leather items or clues related to them, as you draw on your knowledge of leather to pick out details that others would overlook.

features.name: Identify Hides
features.text: When looking at a hide or a leather item, you can determine the source of the leather and any special techniques used to treat it. For example, you can spot the difference between leather crafted using dwarven methods and leather crafted using halfling methods.

features.name: Field Leather Gear
features.text: With suitable hide, leather, buckles, and thread, you can craft or repair mundane travel gear such as belts, pouches, backpacks, straps, scabbards, holsters, harnesses, waterskins, saddles, and similar items.

features.name: Concealed Pocket
features.text: With 4 hours of work, you can add a small concealed pocket to a suitable leather item such as a belt, bag, scabbard, coat panel, or saddle. Make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency; the total becomes the Intelligence (Investigation) check DC needed to notice the pocket.

activities.activity: Modify a leather item's appearance
Determine a leather item's history
Craft a simple leather pouch or belt
Fit a harness or saddle
Add a concealed pocket to a leather item
Identify an unusual hide treatment technique

name: Mason's Tools
summary: Mason's tools allow you to craft stone structures, including walls and buildings crafted from brick.
canDo: Demolition: Your knowledge of masonry allows you to spot weak points in brick walls.
Chisel a small hole in a stone wall
Find a weak point in a stone wall
Seal or reinforce a stone opening
Carve a hidden niche into suitable stonework
components: Mason's tools consist of a trowel, a hammer, a chisel, brushes, and a square.

skillUses.text: Your expertise aids you in identifying a stone building's date of construction and purpose, along with insight into who might have built it.
You gain additional insight when inspecting areas within stone structures.
You can spot irregularities in stone walls or floors, making it easier to find trap doors and secret passages.

features.name: Demolition
features.text: Your knowledge of masonry allows you to spot weak points in brick walls. You deal double damage to such structures with your weapon attacks.

features.name: Stonecraft
features.text: With appropriate stone, mortar, and working space, you can construct or repair mundane stone walls, steps, supports, paving, containers, monuments, and similar masonry. You can restore 10 hit points to a damaged nonmagical stone object or section of masonry for each hour of work if you have suitable raw materials.

features.name: Stone Sculpture
features.text: You can carve statues, busts, reliefs, inscriptions, grave markers, ornaments, and other decorative stonework. The time required depends heavily on size and detail.

activities.activity: Chisel a small hole in a stone wall
Find a weak point in a stone wall
Repair damaged masonry
Carve a simple relief or inscription
Sculpt an accurate bust or small statue
Create a hidden stone niche/passage

name: Painter's Supplies
summary: Proficiency with painter's supplies represents your ability to paint and draw. You also acquire an understanding of art history, which can aid you in examining works of art.
canDo: Painting and Drawing: As part of a quick or short rest (classic short or long rest), you can produce a simple work of art.
Create a painting with a hidden message
Reproduce a visual scene or symbol from memory
components: Painter's supplies include an easel, canvas, paints, brushes, charcoal sticks, and a palette.

skillUses.text: Your expertise aids you in uncovering lore of any sort that is attached to a work of art, such as the magical properties of a painting or the origins of a strange mural found in a dungeon.
When you inspect a painting or a similar work of visual art, your knowledge of the practices behind creating it can grant you additional insight.

features.name: Painting and Drawing
features.text: As part of a quick or short rest (classic short or long rest), you can produce a simple work of art. Although your work might lack precision, you can capture an image or a scene, or make a quick copy of a piece of art you saw.

features.name: Create a work of Art
features.text: During long rest you can create portraits, landscapes, murals, signs, heraldic designs, religious works, and other art. Such art can be sold for possibly a great price. The work's market value depends on materials, quality, reputation, subject, and the local market.

features.name: Field Sketch
features.text: With at least 10 minutes of observation, you can make a useful sketch of a creature, object, symbol, location, or scene. A successful check can preserve identifying details well enough for another person to recognize or investigate the subject later.

activities.activity: Paint an accurate portrait
Create a painting with a hidden message
Paint a clear sign or heraldic device
Reproduce a detailed scene from memory
Create a high-quality painting
Imitate another artist's visual style convincingly

name: Potter's Tools
summary: Potter's tools are used to create a variety of ceramic objects, most typically pots and similar vessels.
canDo: Reconstruction: By examining pottery shards, you can determine an object's original, intact form and its likely purpose.
Determine what a vessel once held
Find a weak point in a ceramic object
Create a sealable ceramic storage vessel
Reconstruct a simple ceramic shape from a surviving fragment
components: Potter's tools include potter's needles, ribs, scrapers, a knife, and calipers.

skillUses.text: Your expertise aids you in identifying ceramic objects, including when they were created and their likely place or culture of origin.
You gain additional insight when inspecting ceramics, uncovering clues others would overlook by spotting minor irregularities.

features.name: Reconstruction
features.text: By examining pottery shards, you can determine an object's original, intact form and its likely purpose.

features.name: Kiln Work
features.text: With access to suitable clay and a kiln or comparable firing setup, you can produce durable mundane ceramic vessels, plates, cups, tiles, bottles, jars, figurines, molds, crucibles, and similar objects. Unfired clay pieces remain fragile and unsuitable for long-term use.

activities.activity: Determine what a vessel once held
Create a serviceable pot
Find a weak point in a ceramic object
Craft simple cups, bowls, or plates
Craft a sealable storage jar or bottle
Craft a detailed clay figurine
Craft a reliable crucible or mold
Create an intricate glazed ornament

name: Smith's Tools
summary: Smith's tools allow you to work metal, heating it to alter its shape, repair damage, or work raw ingots into useful items.
canDo: Repair: With access to your tools and an open flame hot enough to make metal pliable, you can restore 10 hit points to a damaged metal object for each hour of work.
Craft Metal Ammunition and Weapon Parts
Craft Hardware such as nails, hooks, hinges, chains, buckles, and horseshoes
Forge or replace a mundane metal fitting
components: Smith's tools include hammers, tongs, charcoal, rags, and a whetstone.

skillUses.text: Your expertise lends you additional insight when examining metal objects, such as weapons.
You can spot clues and make deductions that others might overlook when an investigation involves armor, weapons, or other metalwork.

features.name: Repair
features.text: With access to your tools and an open flame hot enough to make metal pliable, you can restore 10 hit points to a damaged metal object or 0.5 durability to weapon for each hour of work.

features.name: Forge Hardware
features.text: With access to a suitable forge and raw metal, you can produce mundane hardware and fittings such as nails, hooks, buckles, hinges, brackets, horseshoes, chain links, simple tools, and similar pieces. Precision mechanisms may also require tinker's tools or thieves' tools.

activities.activity: Sharpen a dull blade
Repair a suit of armor
Sunder a nonmagical metal object
Forge a simple metal tool or fitting
Fit a horseshoe or replace a metal fitting
Forge a chain, simple lock body, or precise weapon part
Reproduce a complex metal component from a sample

name: Tinker's Tools
summary: A set of tinker's tools is designed to enable you to repair many mundane objects. Though you can't manufacture much with tinker's tools, you can mend torn clothes, sharpen a worn sword, and patch a tattered suit of chain mail.
canDo: Repair: You can restore 10 hit points to a damaged object for each hour of work.
Repair an item in half the time
Improvise a temporary item using scraps
Craft or Modify Mechanical Trap Components
Disassemble a mechanical device without damaging its useful parts
Identify how a mundane mechanism is intended to operate
Modify a simple trigger, latch, timer, or release mechanism
components: Tinker's tools include a variety of hand tools, thread, needles, a whetstone, scraps of cloth and leather, and a small pot of glue.

skillUses.text: You can determine the age and origin of objects, even if you have only a few pieces remaining from the original.
When you inspect a damaged object, you gain knowledge of how it was damaged and how long ago.

features.name: Repair
features.text: You can restore 10 hit points to a damaged object for each hour of work. For any object, you need access to the raw materials required to repair it. For metal objects, you need access to an open flame hot enough to make the metal pliable.

features.name: Mechanism Analysis
features.text: After 1 minute examining a mundane mechanical device you can reach, you can identify its general purpose, moving parts, likely power source, obvious failure points, and whether it has been damaged or modified. Complex or very unfamiliar mechanisms may require an higher Intelligence check.

features.name: Jury-Rig
features.text: Using suitable scraps and spare parts, you can assemble a temporary mundane mechanism or replacement component. A jury-rigged item is intended as a short-term solution and may fail after heavy use, at the DM's discretion.

activities.activity: Temporarily repair a disabled device
Repair an item in half the time
Improvise a temporary item using scraps
Disassemble a simple device without damaging useful parts
Craft a simple trigger, latch, or release mechanism
Craft a simple lock or mechanical trap component
Reverse-engineer an unfamiliar mechanism

name: Weaver's Tools
summary: Weaver's tools allow you to create cloth and tailor it into articles of clothing.
canDo: Repair: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can repair a single damaged cloth object.
Craft Clothing: Assuming you have access to sufficient cloth and thread, you can create an outfit for a creature as part of a short rest (classic long rest).
Mend a hole in a piece of cloth
Craft Hidden Compartment: Add a concealed pocket or lining to suitable cloth equipment.
Find a hidden compartment in clothing or woven goods
Create simple camouflage cloth suited to local colors and vegetation
components: Weaver's tools include thread, needles, and scraps of cloth. You know how to work a loom, but such equipment is too large to transport.

skillUses.text: Your expertise lends you additional insight when examining cloth objects, including cloaks and robes.

Using your knowledge of the process of creating cloth objects, you can spot clues and make deductions that others would overlook when you examine tapestries, upholstery, clothing, and other woven items.

features.name: Repair
features.text: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can repair a single damaged cloth object.

features.name: Craft Clothing
features.text: Assuming you have access to sufficient cloth and thread, you can create an outfit for a creature as part of a short rest (classic long rest).

features.name: Craft Hidden Compartment
features.text: With 4 hours of work, you can add a concealed pocket, double lining, false seam, or similar compartment to a suitable garment, cloak, bag, blanket, or other woven item. Make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency; the total becomes the Intelligence (Investigation) check DC needed to find the compartment.

features.name: Textile Field Gear
features.text: With sufficient cloth and thread, you can make mundane tents, tarps, blankets, bedrolls, banners, sacks, uniforms, and similar textile goods in addition to ordinary clothing.

activities.activity: Repurpose cloth
Mend a hole in a piece of cloth
Tailor an outfit
Craft a banner, flag, or simple uniform
Craft a hidden compartment in clothing or woven goods
Find a hidden compartment in clothing or woven goods
Reproduce a distinctive uniform or complex textile pattern

name: Woodcarver's Tools
summary: Woodcarver's tools allow you to craft intricate objects from wood, such as wooden tokens or arrows.
canDo: Repair: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can repair a single damaged wooden object.
Craft Arrows: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can craft up to five arrows.
Carve an intricate pattern in wood
Craft Wands, Rods, and Wooden Spell Focuses
Craft Wooden Ornaments and Holy Symbols
Replace a broken wooden haft, shaft, stock, or handle
components: Woodcarver's tools consist of a knife, a gouge, and a small saw.

skillUses.text: Your expertise lends you additional insight when you examine wooden objects, such as figurines or arrows.
Your knowledge of wooden objects gives you some added insight when you examine trees.

features.name: Repair
features.text: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can repair a single damaged wooden object.

features.name: Craft Arrows
features.text: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can craft up to five arrows. As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can craft up to twenty. You must have enough wood on hand to produce them.

features.name: Weapon Stock and Shaft
features.text: With suitable wood, you can craft or replace mundane wooden weapon bodies and components such as staffs, clubs, spear shafts, axe handles, bow bodies, crossbow stocks, and similar parts. Weapons that require metal mechanisms, blades, strings, or fittings may also require smith's tools, tinker's tools, or atleast other  materials.

features.name: Focus Carving
features.text: You can carve wands, rods, wooden holy symbols, totems, decorative grips, and other compact wooden objects intended as mundane spellcasting or ceremonial components.

activities.activity: Craft a small wooden figurine
Carve an intricate pattern in wood
Craft a staff, club, handle, or spear shaft
Fit or replace a wooden weapon component
Craft a bow body or crossbow stock
Carve a precise wand, rod, or other wooden spell focus
Craft a masterwork wooden weapon

name: Disguise Kit
summary: This pouch of cosmetics, hair dye, and small props lets you create disguises that change your physical appearance. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to create a visual disguise. The perfect tool for anyone who wants to engage in trickery, a disguise kit enables its owner to adopt a false identity.
canDo: Create Disguise: As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can create a disguise.
Spot a disguise being used by someone else
Change a creature's apparent age, profession, or social status
Create theatrical makeup and simple costume props
Reproduce the visible look of a known uniform when suitable clothing is available
components: A disguise kit includes cosmetics, hair dye, small props, and a few pieces of clothing.

skillUses.text: In certain cases, a disguise can improve your ability to weave convincing lies.
The right disguise can make you look more fearsome, whether you want to scare someone away by posing as a plague victim or intimidate a gang of thugs by taking the appearance of a bully.
A cunning disguise can enhance an audience's enjoyment of a performance, provided the disguise is properly designed to evoke the desired reaction.
Folk tend to trust a person in uniform. If you disguise yourself as an authority figure, your efforts to persuade others are often more effective.

features.name: Create Disguise
features.text: As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can create a disguise. It takes you 1 minute to don such a disguise once you have created it. You can carry only one such disguise on you at a time without drawing undue attention, unless you have a bag of holding or a similar method to keep them hidden. Each disguise weighs 1 pound. At other times, it takes 10 minutes to craft a disguise that involves moderate changes to your appearance, and 30 minutes for one that requires more extensive changes.

features.name: Disguise Another
features.text: You can create and apply a disguise to a willing creature using the same general process and time requirements as creating a disguise for yourself. Significant differences in body shape, species, or size may increase the difficulty or make a disguise impossible without additional props or clothing.

features.name: Role Disguise
features.text: If you have seen appropriate examples, you can build a disguise around a recognizable social role such as a servant, guard, clerk, priest, laborer, noble, or performer. This changes appearance, not knowledge, mannerisms, credentials, or authority.

activities.activity: Cover injuries or distinguishing marks
Spot a disguise being used by someone else
Copy a humanoid's appearance
Change apparent age, profession, or social status
Disguise another willing creature
Reproduce a recognizable uniform or occupational appearance
Mimic a specific individual's distinguishing visual features (Race/Size complications migh apply)

name: Forgery Kit
summary: This small box contains a variety of papers and parchments, pens and inks, seals and sealing wax, gold and silver leaf, and other supplies necessary to create convincing forgeries of physical documents. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to create a physical forgery of a document. A forgery kit is designed to duplicate documents and to make it easier to copy a person's seal or signature.
canDo: Other Tools: Knowledge of other tools makes your forgeries that much more believable.
Quick Fake: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can produce a forged document no more than one page in length.
Craft False Passes, Permits, Warrants, Invitations, Tickets, and Certificates
Alter a small detail in an existing document
Counterfeit a map when combined with appropriate cartographic knowledge
Match the apparent age, paper type, ink style, or administrative format of a document
components: A forgery kit includes several different types of ink, a variety of parchments and papers, several quills, seals and sealing wax, gold and silver leaf, and small tools to sculpt melted wax to mimic a seal.

skillUses.text: A forgery kit can be used in conjunction with the Arcana skill to determine if a magic item is real or fake.
A well-crafted forgery, such as papers proclaiming you to be a noble or a writ that grants you safe passage, can lend credence to a lie.
A forgery kit combined with your knowledge of history improves your ability to create fake historical documents or to tell if an old document is authentic.
When you examine objects, proficiency with a forgery kit is useful for determining how an object was made and whether it is genuine.

features.name: Other Tools
features.text: Knowledge of other tools makes your forgeries that much more believable. For example, you could combine proficiency with a forgery kit and proficiency with cartographer's tools to make a fake map.

features.name: Quick Fake
features.text: As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can produce a forged document no more than one page in length. As part of a short rest (classic long rest), you can produce a document that is up to four pages long. Your Intelligence check using a forgery kit determines the DC for someone else's Intelligence (Investigation) check to spot the fake.

features.name: Alter Document
features.text: You can alter a limited detail in an existing mundane document, such as a name, date, destination, amount, signature line, or authorization mark. Make an Intelligence check using your tool proficiency; the total becomes the Intelligence (Investigation) check DC needed to notice the alteration. Major changes may require recreating the entire document instead.

activities.activity: Mimic handwriting
Duplicate a wax seal
Alter a simple name, date, or number in a document
Create a convincing official pass or permit
Match an unusual paper, ink, or administrative style
Create a convincing multi-page forged record

name: Navigator's Tools
summary: This set of instruments is used for navigation at sea. Proficiency with navigator's tools lets you chart a ship's course and follow navigation charts. In addition, these tools allow you to add your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make to avoid getting lost at sea. Proficiency with navigator's tools helps you determine a true course based on observing the stars. It also grants you insight into charts and maps while developing your sense of direction.
canDo: Sighting: By taking careful measurements, you can determine your position on a nautical chart and the time of day.
Discover your position on a nautical chart
Determine cardinal direction from the stars
Estimate local time from celestial observations
components: Navigator's tools include a sextant, a compass, calipers, a ruler, parchment, ink, and a quill.

skillUses.text: Knowledge of navigator's tools helps you avoid becoming lost and also grants you insight into the most likely location for roads and settlements.

features.name: Sighting
features.text: By taking careful measurements, you can determine your position on a nautical chart and the time of day.

features.name: Dead Reckoning
features.text: If you know your approximate starting position, direction of travel, speed, and elapsed time, you can estimate your current position even without visible landmarks. Poor weather, currents, detours, difficult terrain, or unreliable measurements can require a Wisdom or Intelligence check.

features.name: Celestial Navigation
features.text: When the sky is sufficiently visible, you can use the sun, stars, and other celestial references to determine direction and approximate time, and to help correct accumulated navigation error.

activities.activity: Plot a course
Discover your position on a nautical chart
Determine cardinal direction from visible stars
Estimate local time from celestial observations
Plot an overland course through known terrain
Recover an estimated position after a storm or major detour

name: Poisoner's Kit
summary: A poisoner's kit includes the vials, chemicals, and other equipment necessary for the creation of poisons. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to craft or use poisons. Additionally, the Crafting and Harvesting Poison rules require the use of a poisoner's kit. A poisoner's kit is a favored resource for thieves, assassins, and others who engage in skulduggery. It allows you to apply poisons and create them from various materials. Your knowledge of poisons also helps you treat them.
canDo: Handle Poison: Your proficiency allows you to handle and apply a poison without risk of exposing yourself to its effects.
Determine the effects of a poison
Harvest poison or venom from a suitable creature or plant
Preserve a poison or venom sample
Dilute or concentrate a poison preparation
Safely coat ammunition, weapons, or traps with poison
components: A poisoner's kit includes glass vials, a mortar and pestle, chemicals, and a glass stirring rod.

skillUses.text: Your training with poisons can help you when you try to recall facts about infamous poisonings.
Your knowledge of poisons has taught you to handle those substances carefully, giving you an edge when you inspect poisoned objects or try to extract clues from events that involve poison.
When you treat the victim of a poison, your knowledge grants you added insight into how to provide the best care to your patient.
Working with poisons enables you to acquire lore about which plants and animals are poisonous.

features.name: Handle Poison
features.text: Your proficiency allows you to handle and apply a poison without risk of exposing yourself to its effects.

features.name: Harvest Poison
features.text: When you have access to a suitable poisonous creature, plant, gland, sac, secretion, or similar source, you can attempt to harvest a usable poison or venom sample without exposing yourself. The DC depends on the source and condition of the material; particularly dangerous or delicate sources may require a higher check.

features.name: Specific Antidote
features.text: If you can identify a particular poison and obtain suitable reagents, you can formulate an antidote intended for that poison. A specific antidote is not a universal antitoxin and does not automatically neutralize unrelated poisons.

activities.activity: Spot a poisoned object
Determine the effects of a poison
Preserve a poison or venom sample
Harvest poison or venom from a suitable source
Determine suitable ingredients for a specific antidote
Formulate a specific antidote or poison

name: Thieves' Tools
summary: This set of tools includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency with these tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to disarm traps or open locks. Perhaps the most common tools used by adventurers, thieves' tools are designed for picking locks and foiling traps. Proficiency with the tools also grants you a general knowledge of traps and locks.
canDo: Set a Trap: Just as you can disable traps, you can also set them.
Make an impression of a key
Duplicate a simple key from an impression when suitable material or a blank is available
Jam or deliberately foul a lock
Assess the quality and mechanism of a lock
components: Thieves' tools include a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers.

skillUses.text: Your knowledge of traps grants you insight when answering questions about locations that are renowned for their traps.
You gain additional insight when looking for traps, because you have learned a variety of common signs that betray their presence.

features.name: Set a Trap
features.text: Just as you can disable traps, you can also set them. As part of a quick rest (classic short rest), you can create a trap using items you have on hand. The total of your check becomes the DC for someone else's attempt to discover or disable the trap. The trap deals damage appropriate to the materials used in crafting it (such as poison or a weapon) or damage equal to half the total of your check, whichever the DM deems appropriate.

features.name: Assess Lock
features.text: After 1 minute examining a mundane lock you can reach, you can identify its general mechanism, quality, obvious damage, whether it has been tampered with, and the likely difficulty of opening it. Unusual or concealed mechanisms may require an Intelligence check.

features.name: Key Impression
features.text: With wax, clay, soap, or another suitable soft material and brief access to a key, you can make an impression of it. Given an appropriate blank or workable material, you can later attempt to shape a duplicate simple key.

activities.activity: Pick a lock
Disable a trap
Identify a lock's mechanism and quality
Jam a mundane lock
Duplicate a simple key from an impression
Construct a simple lock
Alter a mechanical trap trigger without fully disarming it

name: Herbalism Kit
summary: This kit contains a variety of instruments such as clippers, mortar and pestle, and pouches and vials used by herbalists to create remedies and potions. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to identify or apply herbs. Also, proficiency with this kit is required to create antitoxin and potions of healing. Proficiency with an herbalism kit allows you to identify plants and safely collect their useful elements.
canDo: Preserve harvested herbs and medicinal plants
Identify the likely medicinal use of an unfamiliar plant
components: An herbalism kit includes pouches to store herbs, clippers and leather gloves for collecting plants, a mortar and pestle, and several glass jars.

skillUses.text: Your knowledge of the nature and uses of herbs can add insight to your magical studies that deal with plants and your attempts to identify potions.
When you inspect an area overgrown with plants, your proficiency can help you pick out details and clues that others might miss.
Your mastery of herbalism improves your ability to treat illnesses and wounds by augmenting your methods of care with medicinal plants.
When you travel in the wild, your skill in herbalism makes it easier to identify plants and spot sources of food that others might overlook.

features.name: Identify Plants
features.text: You can identify most plants with a quick inspection of their appearance and smell.

features.name: Antitoxin and Antidotes
features.text: You can use an herbalism kit to create antitoxin. If you know the nature of a specific poison and have access to appropriate medicinal plants or other natural reagents, you can also attempt to create an antidote tailored to that poison. A specific antidote does not automatically work against unrelated poisons.

features.name: Preserve Herbs
features.text: You can dry, press, wrap, salt, steep, or otherwise preserve freshly gathered herbs and medicinal plant material to prevent ordinary spoilage during travel and storage, provided the plant can reasonably be preserved by mundane means.

activities.activity: Find plants
Identify poison
Prepare a simple medicinal poultice or herbal remedy
Preserve harvested herbs and medicinal plants
Identify the likely medicinal property of an unfamiliar plant
Create a specific herbal antidote

name: Accountant's Tools
summary: Accountant's tools are used to count money, maintain financial records, calculate costs and payments, track time and schedules, and uncover discrepancies in accounts. A skilled accountant can quickly determine whether numbers add up, estimate the financial requirements of a project, and recognize when records have been altered or manipulated.
canDo: Quick Calculation: You can rapidly perform arithmetic involving money, quantities, time, wages, prices, debts, interest, or similar practical calculations.
Bookkeeping: You can maintain organized records of income, expenses, inventory, debts, wages, and payments.
Estimate the cost of a project
Calculate wages, taxes, fees, interest, or shares
Count a large amount of coins or goods
Spot a discrepancy in financial records
Estimate elapsed time from schedules or records
components: Accountant's tools include a counting board or abacus, a small set of calibrated weights, chalk, ink, quills, several sheets of parchment, a ledger, and measuring cords or marked strips used for keeping track of quantities and time.

skillUses.text: Your knowledge of accounting can help you understand old prices, wages, taxes, trade practices, currencies, financial institutions, and records of historical transactions.

When examining ledgers, receipts, inventories, contracts, schedules, or other records containing numbers, your proficiency helps you notice inconsistencies, missing entries, manipulated totals, or patterns that others might overlook.

Financial records can reveal behavior. Repeated withdrawals, unusual expenses, hidden debts, or deliberately vague bookkeeping can provide insight into the motives or habits of the person maintaining the accounts.

features.name: Quick Calculation
features.text: When you have the necessary information available, you can quickly perform ordinary calculations involving money, quantities, time, wages, prices, debts, interest, shares, travel expenses, or similar practical matters without requiring a check. Particularly complicated, incomplete, or deliberately misleading calculations may still require an Intelligence check using your accountant's tools.

features.name: Bookkeeping
features.text: You can maintain accurate records of a group's income, expenses, inventory, wages, debts, and payments. If you have maintained the records yourself, you can determine the current totals and identify when something has been added, removed, or changed without authorization.

features.name: Project Estimate
features.text: Given sufficient information about materials, workers, prices, and expected working time, you can estimate the cost and duration of a construction project, expedition, business venture, production run, or similar undertaking. The estimate is reasonably accurate unless important information was unavailable or deliberately concealed.

activities.activity: Count and verify a large quantity of coins or goods
Calculate complicated costs, wages, interest, taxes, or shares
Estimate the cost and duration of a project
Spot an error or discrepancy in financial records
Determine when a transaction or recorded event occurred from incomplete records
Detect deliberately manipulated or fraudulent accounting
Reconstruct incomplete or damaged financial records

name: Fishing Rod
summary: A fishing rod is a simple tool used to catch fish in rivers, lakes, ponds, and coastal waters. Proficiency with a fishing rod represents practical knowledge of bait, casting, suitable fishing spots, and recognizing when a fish has taken the hook.
components: A fishing rod consists of a wooden rod, fishing line, hooks, a small float or weight, and a small amount of basic tackle.

skillUses.text: Your fishing experience helps you recognize suitable fishing locations, choose appropriate bait, and understand the habits of common freshwater and coastal fish.

features.name: Fishing
features.text: If you spend at least 1 hour fishing in waters that contain edible fish, you can attempt a check using your fishing rod. On a success, you catch enough fish to provide food for one creature for one day. Particularly rich or poor fishing grounds can increase or decrease the amount caught at the DM's discretion.

activities.activity: Catch fish in suitable waters
Catch fish in poor or difficult waters
Catch fish in at sea wile baot is sailing
